provenance: GNSA operational guidance approved by the GNSA STA team (corrected KYC answers); not independently verified on the website and not a regulatory circular.
facts: GNSA INFOTECH PRIVATE LIMITED receives applicable completed and signed physical-folio KYC forms with self-attested supporting documents by post/courier; in-person submission is also described in the supplied folio-compliance guidance.

GNSA verifies submitted documents and updates its records. The supplied approved guidance states that a confirmation email is sent to the registered email ID after successful KYC updating, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.

The supplied GNSA guidance uses banker-authenticated ISR-2 with a cancelled cheque for signature mismatch and change in specimen signature. Required KYC documents accompany a signature change where applicable. This preferred procedure does not mean regulatory alternatives are forbidden.
Demat KYC updates are handled by the shareholder's Depository Participant.
